entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A planeswalker artificially created on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld; his Spark ignited when he failed.

entities.name: The God of Destiny
entities.description: The god on Theros who artificially created Calix.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker Calix was created to stop from escaping the Underworld.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Calix was created.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: The place on Theros from which Elspeth Tirel was to be prevented from escaping.

events.summary: The God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.
events.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.

events.summary: Calix fails in his duty and his fated purpose ignites his Spark, letting him pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.
events.quote: When Calix failed in his duty, his fated purpose ignited his Spark, allowing him to pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.

relations.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros

relations.note: Created to prevent her escape; pursues her across the multiverse.
relations.quote: allowing him to pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.
